reply1:
**Draft:** The email is already close to plain. I tightened the first sentence, which strings two facts together with "and finished," and merged the two questions about coverage into one. I kept the 15-minute ask as its own line.

**Remaining patterns:** I found no strong tells: no contrasts, closers, dashes, or inflated claims. The "where we might fit" phrasing is a little soft, but cold emails commonly use it, so I left it. I added no facts.

<final>
Subject: Same-day refrigerated delivery for Fairview Markets

Hi [First Name],

We provide refrigerated trucking with same-day delivery within 250 miles. Last year, 99.2% of our deliveries arrived on time. Could we help Fairview Markets with regular routes or last-minute delivery needs?

Do you have 15 minutes next week to talk about where we might fit?

Best,
[Your Name]
[Company]
[Phone]
</final>
